c74object.name: evi_formletfilter
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A ringing formlet filter model
c74object.description:
evi_formletfilter is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_formletfilter.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_formletfilter is also available in MSP as: evi.formletfilter~.
A physical modelling ringing formlet filter loosely based on SuperCollider 'Formlet()' with added modulation and control features. Created by adding two resonant filters together around a center frequency. Can create ringing tones out of any input material. This is a direct form filter, so modulation is limited.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: (Impulse). Audio input to be filtered, typically an impulse-like event.

geninlet.name: filter
geninlet.digest: Frequency in PITCH. Filter frequency is set in Pitch (e.g. MIDI 0..127).

attribute.name: attack
attribute.description: Filter ringing T60 attack time in ms. Like setting an envelope attack.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: Filter ringing T60 decay time in ms. Like setting an envelope decay. Note this is a T60 time and therefore does not reach it's destination exactly.

attribute.name: offset
attribute.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, filter cutoff (inlet 2) offset ± 2 octaves.

attribute.name: smoothfreq
attribute.description: Optional frequency (inlet 2) smoothing time in ms.

attribute.name: smoothtime
attribute.description: Optional @attack / @decay smoothing time in ms. In general this is not needed.

attribute.name: spread
attribute.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, bandwidth spread ± 1 octave. This spreads the cutoffs of the two internal resonant filters apart from one another.

attribute.name: width
attribute.description: Modulation in semitones. Set in Pitch, bandwidth up to 2 octaves in size. This sets the size of the frequency band centered by the cutoff (inlet 2).
